question_text: A BST has root8; left child4 and right child10. Node4 has left3 and right6; node6 has right7; node10 has right11. Sketch the BST after deleting8, using its inorder successor.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Root10; left subtree4 with left3 and right6(right7); right child11.
